Fixed in `anthrouter/request_text.py`: `strip_reminders` now ends with `.strip()`. Your example now returns `True`. I couldn't run the test suite because pytest isn't installed here. The only check was running your example by hand.

**Root cause:** the docstring promised "trim outer whitespace", but the function never did it. Removing the `<system-reminder>` block left a leading `\n`. `is_activity_label_prompt` then ran `.startswith('Describe …')` on the untrimmed text and failed.

Because the fix is in `strip_reminders`, every caller gets the trimmed text.

I did not check whether any existing test or other caller relied on the untrimmed output.
